# Component patterns

Open relevant files when the change contains (or needs to contain) the matching widget. Don't read every file.

- `checkbox-group.md` — multi-select checkboxes in a group.
- `radio-button-group.md` — single-select radios in a group.
- `single-checkbox.md` — standalone consent / toggle checkbox.
- `forms.md` — forms (inputs/fields).
- `disclosure-widget.md` — button + hidden panel (FAQs, "show more").
- `modal-dialog.md` — blocking overlay with focus trap.
- `page-layout.md` — full views (primarily web): landmarks, skip link, navigation, cards, promos.

Each file follows the same shape: **Principles (platform-agnostic) → Web implementation (Generate defaults → Minimal pattern → Review checklist → Pitfalls)**.
